mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates economic weakness, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 showed a sustained increase over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals supply chain disruptions, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 1% in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strong consumer demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased and UNRATE decreased in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable economic environment, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL remained below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 300,000 in the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures by more than 1% in a month signals weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS declined by more than 1% in the previous month.
